description: Native-only SendDestination vectors for inputs bark 0.8 (959a489f) accepts and RN refused: ffi-phase-b.md rows 5, 16, 18 and 19, with rows 3, 9 and 17 kept. Same shape as send-utils, plus `url` for lnurl: the HTTPS endpoint resolution requests first (null: resolution refuses before any request). `error` is the English message. Hand-specified; shared by Android and iOS.
